Hikaru"Kageaki, now you are not going to start talking in your sleep, na? By this time Muramasa you should have understood."
Kageaki"...!"
Hikaru"...You do understand. Achha. That is more like it."
Hikaru"Then explaining also becomes easier. With this might, Hikaru shall illuminate the world."
Hikaru"People remaining merely human, huddling nicely in little groups—that age, here itself I shall CHOP OFF. Each person living as they please, fighting as they please, killing as they please! That age I shall bring!"
Kageaki"—An age?"
Kageaki"No age will come from this. Only ruin."

en.html:
Hikaru"Haan! Exactly!"
Kageaki"Hh...!?"
Hikaru"Humanity will perish... and whoever wins at the very end earns the right to call themselves God—Heaven itself!"
Hikaru"There. Hikaru's path of dominion, you have it."
Kageaki"What bloody nonsense!"
Hikaru"Hm. Somewhere I have made a mistake? ...No. Not possible, surely."
Hikaru"Logic ko dekho. To qualify as God, only ONE method is there! Fight the WHOLE of humanity and WIN!!"
Kageaki"————"
Hikaru"First, of course, the whole of humanity must come onto the battlefield. Such unexpected good fortune: Muramasa's song, those contamination waves, can pass Hikaru's own mind into other people."
Hikaru"Weak people see a sword and run. Chase them and cut them from behind? Arre, such cowardly, low-class work. Make them fierce beasts, fighting as they desire, and fight them as equals! Then only victory has any meaning."
Hikaru"A FAIR contest I shall have, and at the very top I shall stand. Once I become God—Hikaru's purpose, her dream, will be fulfilled also."
Kageaki"...Purpose?"

Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"...Love...?"
Hikaru"Fire in the heart must be there... then only can flesh be forged into fighting steel."
Kageaki"Making people kill each other... Is that your love for humanity?"
Hikaru"Of course not. ...Though better it might have been, had that been the case."
Hikaru"Regrettably, that much vastness Hikaru's heart did not possess. Love the whole of humanity? This feeling is for one individual only."
Hikaru"............Kageaki, do not make a girl discuss all this. Family you are, agreed, but straight inside my heart you are coming. It is... embarrassing, samjhe?"
Kageaki"..."
